title: #elf #elfthemusical #elfonbroadway #elfbroadway #greyhenson #greyhens...
transcript: The other night, I saw Elf on Broadway. Based on the iconic 2003 movie which I've actually never seen, Elf The Musical is a family friendly musical comedy about Buddy The Elf who goes on an adventure to New York City to meet his father and save Christmas. Okay, call me Scrooge but I didn't like this — but I can see why other people do. I thought the story was tired and the music was generic, but I guess it was fun for what it was. For how bland I thought the material was, Grey Henson as Buddy was wonderful, perfect casting, actually. To me he completely carried the show with his delightfully silly and spontaneous performance. And when he's not making you laugh, he's leading a good amount of big ensemble numbers, some of which do have some cool theatrical staging. I would think that if you like the movie, you'll enjoy this — it's pretty much exactly what it's marketed as. Also, this is a seasonal touristy show so expect seasonal touristy audience behavior. With that another playbill for my collection.
